subject: Runtime data ownership & audit request — log preservation and evidence
messages:
From: Alice Moran <alice@finbridge.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-01T15:12:00Z
Subject: Urgent: payment flows failing — need logs & preservation

Vanessa,

We just experienced a severe degradation impacting payment authorizations starting ~2027-05-01T14:38Z. Our telemetry shows ~500% spike in 500 errors and time-to-first-byte spiked from ~120ms to ~2.1s for the Redwood inference calls used in our tokenization+fraud-check step. This is causing a backlog across several customer transactions.

We're preparing an internal audit packet for our compliance team and external regulators. Can you confirm:
- Whether Redwood will preserve all request/response runtime logs (raw payloads, timestamps, request ids) for the window 2027-05-01T14:30:00Z - 2027-05-01T15:00:00Z?
- The current retention policy for those artifacts and whether they can be put on legal hold immediately.
- Whether any sensitive PII or card data could have been captured in logs during tokenization (we expect Redwood to have redaction policies but need explicit confirmation).
- The process and timeline to produce a signed chain-of-custody/audit evidence pack (hashed logs, timeline, operator actions).

We need these items urgently to brief our CS and security leadership. Please treat as incident severity=high.

Thanks,
Alice Moran\Security & Compliance\FinBridge

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Alice Moran <alice@finbridge.com>
Cc: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-01T15:32:00Z
Subject: Re: Urgent: payment flows failing — need logs & preservation

Alice — thanks for the heads up and very sorry for the impact. We are escalating immediately.

Preliminary answers and actions we are taking now:
- I have instructed infra to preserve all runtime artifacts for the window you listed and to suspend retention trimming for those buckets. See internal preserve request below.
- Standard retention for detailed request logs is 30 days; we will put the requested slice on legal hold and produce an audit pack.
- Redwood enforces automatic redaction of common sensitive fields (credit_card_number, ssn, full_pan) at ingestion; however we will validate the redaction for any logs from your calls and include evidence in the pack.
- We will provide a chain-of-custody statement, MD5/SHA256 hashes of artifacts, and an incident timeline within 24 hours; full evidence pack within 72 hours unless legal requests accelerate.

Attached: preservation_notice.txt (stub) — confirms hold initiation.

I will keep you updated as infra confirms extraction locations and custody steps.

– Vanessa Ortiz\Head of Customer Success\Redwood Inference

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-01T15:45:00Z
Subject: Action: preserve runtime artifacts for FinBridge incident (20270501 window)

Sean — please treat as highest priority. Customer FinBridge reported a major spike at ~14:38Z. Steps I need you to execute now: 
1) Identify and snapshot all request/response logs, application traces, and scheduler metrics for the time window 2027-05-01T14:30:00Z - 2027-05-01T15:00:00Z for model endpoints used by FinBridge (route: /v1/gen/finbridge-tokenize and /v1/infer/fraud-check).
2) Suspend log rotation and any background TTL deletion on S3 indices that contain those artifacts.
3) Take a filesystem snapshot of the serving nodes attached to that tenant pool and upload tarball to s3://redwood-internal/finbridge/incidents/20270501/ with MD5 and SHA256.
4) Produce an initial hashed bundle (MD5+SHA256) and a short chain-of-custody note with who performed each step.
5) Confirm whether raw payloads contain any non-redacted PAN/PII — if you find unredacted fields, flag immediately and isolate a copy for legal.

I attached a short checklist: checklist_preserve.docx (stub). Let me know the expected ETA for the artifacts.

On urgency: customer asked for an audit-ready pack within 24–72 hours. If we can't meet that SLA, ping me and aditya to route to execs.

—Vanessa

From: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-01T16:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Action: preserve runtime artifacts for FinBridge incident (20270501 window)

Vanessa — ack, taking ownership. Worklog below and immediate locations: 
- Preserved indices: s3://redwood-internal/finbridge/incidents/20270501/raw-logs/ (snapshot created 2027-05-01T15:48:12Z). Rotation disabled on those prefixes.
- Kibana saved query: finbridge-20270501-window (link: https://kibana.redwood.internal/app/discover#/finbridge-errors?_a=(query:(query_string:(query:'finbridge AND 2027-05-01T14:30:00Z'))))
- Snapshot tarball: runtime_snapshot.tar.gz (stub) uploaded to s3://redwood-internal/finbridge/incidents/20270501/artifacts/runtime_snapshot.tar.gz with SHA256: e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb924.
- Quick scan for unredacted PAN/PII: initial heuristics show no PAN patterns in the request bodies for the endpoints listed; will run a secondary regex/audit.
- Estimated evidence pack ETA: initial timeline + hashes within 6 hours; full package (hashed logs, timeline, operator actions) within 36–48 hours barring legal changes.

Attachments attached to this note: runtime_snapshot.tar.gz (stub).

— Sean Gallagher\Senior Site Reliability Engineer\Redwood Inference

Date: 2027-05-01T16:50:00Z
Subject: Request: legal hold + audit pack coordination for FinBridge incident

Aditya — looping you in. FinBridge has requested an audit-ready evidence pack (timeline, hashed artifacts, chain-of-custody, redaction verification). Sean has taken a snapshot and disabled rotation.

Can legal confirm:
- Acceptance of the plan to produce hashed logs and a chain-of-custody statement (we will include operator sign-offs).
- Whether we should redact any PII from the evidence pack prior to delivery or provide a redaction-proof hash and a separate redacted package.
- Any additional legal sign-off or NDA amendment required to transfer preserved logs to FinBridge SOC.

Customer impact: payments delayed; they want incident-level assurance and a signed statement. Please advise priority and whether we should escalate to execs for a faster SLA.

— Monica Patel\Director, Customer Reliability\Redwood Inference

To: Alice Moran <alice@finbridge.com>
Cc: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T09:10:00Z
Subject: FinBridge incident — preliminary evidence and next steps

Alice — quick update and attachments. Thank you for patience.

What we are delivering now (initial bundle):
- incident_timeline.csv (preliminary timeline of events and SRE actions)
- runtime_snapshot.tar.gz (preserved artifact; hashes attached)
- slo_impact_summary.pdf (high-level SLO impact for the payment route)

Notes:
- Sean has disabled rotation and taken snapshots; initial scans show no unredacted PAN/PII in the endpoints you called; we will produce the redaction verification report as part of the full pack.
- We will provide a signed chain-of-custody and MD5/SHA256 hashes with operator sign-offs in the full evidence pack within 36–48 hours.
- If FinBridge's SOC requires direct access to artifacts, we can facilitate a secure transfer (S3 presigned, or staged SFTP) under an agreed access attestation. Please let us know your preference.

Attachments: incident_timeline.csv, slo_impact_summary.pdf, runtime_snapshot.tar.gz (stubs).

Next step: Monica and I will coordinate with Aditya for legal packaging and delivery; expect a formal evidence pack notification by EOD 2027-05-02.

Regards,
Vanessa Ortiz\Head of Customer Success\Redwood Inference
